node.statement: Assume epsilon>0. If d_0<=2K epsilon, the single correction specified in 1.1 stops with d_1<=2K epsilon. Otherwise repeatedly invoke lem-maincb-improvement-one-step while d_j>2K epsilon and stop at the first N>=1 with d_N<=2K epsilon. This N is finite because before stopping the estimate in 1.1 gives d_j<=(3/4)^j d_0, and a positive geometric sequence eventually falls below 2K epsilon. Every correction output is dagger-preserving, so v_N is dagger-preserving; it is an extended d_N-inclusion with d_N<=K_floor epsilon. Unpacking def-extended-delta-inclusion, each defect and norm inequality with parameter d_N remains valid after replacing d_N by the larger K_floor epsilon, so v_N is an extended K_floor*epsilon-inclusion, with v_{N,n}=I_n tensor v_N.
